title: Senior Product Designer Advancement roadmap
summary: A step-by-step plan to deepen product thinking, sharpen design execution, build showcase projects, and prepare for senior-level roles. Focuses on leadership, metrics, and interview readiness.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Refresh core design mindsets and collaboration fundamentals.

milestones.title: Product Thinking refresh
milestones.outcome: Can articulate product vision, strategy, and success metrics for any initiative.

tasks.title: Read the product thinking guide on Medium
tasks.description: Skim the “Product Thinking” series on Medium to capture the 5-step framework.

tasks.title: Map a product canvas for a familiar app
tasks.description: Create a one-page canvas (problem, users, solution, metrics) in Google Docs.

tasks.title: Write a 200-word value proposition
tasks.description: Summarize the core value of the chosen app for its primary user segment.

tasks.title: Discuss the canvas with a peer
tasks.description: Schedule a 30-minute call to get feedback on assumptions and gaps.

milestones.title: User research foundations
milestones.outcome: Can plan and conduct a basic qualitative study and synthesize findings.

tasks.title: Watch Nielsen Norman Group research basics video
tasks.description: View the 20-minute overview on research methods on NN/g’s free site.

tasks.title: Create a research plan template
tasks.description: Draft a one-page plan (goals, participants, methods, timeline) in Notion.

tasks.title: Recruit 3 participants for a 15-minute interview
tasks.description: Use LinkedIn or a community to schedule short user interviews.

tasks.title: Summarize interview insights in an affinity map
tasks.description: Group raw quotes into themes on a Miro board.

tasks.title: Reflect on research biases
tasks.description: Write a short note on any assumptions that surfaced and how to mitigate them.

milestones.title: Collaboration with engineers
milestones.outcome: Can translate design decisions into clear technical specifications.

tasks.title: Read the Figma-to-dev handoff guide on Figma help Center
tasks.description: Study the official handoff documentation (15 min).

tasks.title: Create a design spec for a simple component
tasks.description: Document layout, states, and interaction notes in Figma’s specs panel.

tasks.title: Host a 20-minute design review with an engineer
tasks.description: Walk through the spec, collect feasibility feedback, and note action items.

tasks.title: Write a concise API-design checklist
tasks.description: List five items to verify before handing off any UI component.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Deepen interaction design, tooling, and data-driven decision making.

milestones.title: Advanced interaction design
milestones.outcome: Can prototype complex flows with micro-interactions and accessibility considerations.

tasks.title: Complete the freeCodeCamp UI design course module on micro-interactions
tasks.description: Finish the 2-hour video and exercises on interaction details.

tasks.title: Prototype a multi-step checkout flow in Figma
tasks.description: Build frames, add overlays, and define transition timings.

tasks.title: Test the prototype with 2 users for 5-minute tasks
tasks.description: Observe task completion and note friction points.

tasks.title: Add ARIA labels to all interactive elements
tasks.description: Ensure each component meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards.

tasks.title: Document interaction guidelines for the flow
tasks.description: Create a one-page style guide covering timing, easing, and feedback.

milestones.title: Figma for teams
milestones.outcome: Can run design systems, libraries, and collaborative sessions efficiently.

tasks.title: Read Figma’s design system documentation
tasks.description: Skim the official guide on libraries and tokens (20 min).

tasks.title: Create a shared component library for a mock product
tasks.description: Build 10 reusable components and publish them to a team file.

tasks.title: Run a 30-minute design critique live in Figma
tasks.description: Invite a peer, use comment mode, and iterate on feedback.

tasks.title: Set up auto-layout for responsive cards
tasks.description: Apply constraints and test resizing across breakpoints.

tasks.title: Write a quick-start guide for new designers
tasks.description: Summarize library usage, naming conventions, and versioning in a Confluence page.

milestones.title: Metrics-driven design
milestones.outcome: Can define, track, and iterate on key product metrics linked to design decisions.

tasks.title: Read the Amplitude “Product metrics” guide
tasks.description: Read the free introductory PDF (15 min).

tasks.title: Identify 3 North Star metrics for a chosen product
tasks.description: Write a brief rationale for each metric in a Google Sheet.

tasks.title: Set up a mock dashboard in Google data Studio
tasks.description: Connect sample CSV data and visualize the metrics.

tasks.title: Analyze a recent design change’s impact
tasks.description: Use the mock dashboard to simulate A/B results and write insights.

tasks.title: Reflect on metric selection biases
tasks.description: Note any over-reliance on vanity metrics and propose alternatives.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create portfolio-ready case studies that demonstrate end-to-end ownership.

milestones.title: End-to-end Product case study
milestones.outcome: A publishable case study showing research, design, handoff, and outcomes.

tasks.title: Select a real problem you solved at work
tasks.description: Write a one-sentence problem statement and impact goal.

tasks.title: Document research findings in a narrative format
tasks.description: Create a 2-page PDF using the research template from Phase 1.

tasks.title: Show high-fidelity screens with interaction specs
tasks.description: Export annotated frames from Figma and embed them in the case study.

tasks.title: Write a results section with metrics
tasks.description: Include before/after numbers and a brief analysis.

tasks.title: Publish the case study on your portfolio site
tasks.description: Add SEO-friendly titles and a short intro on your personal website.

milestones.title: Feature spec with designs
milestones.outcome: A detailed spec document paired with UI mockups ready for engineering handoff.

tasks.title: Choose a feature to redesign or build from scratch
tasks.description: Define scope and success criteria in a one-page brief.

tasks.title: Write a feature spec using the template from Phase 1
tasks.description: Include user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.

tasks.title: Create corresponding high-fidelity mockups in Figma
tasks.description: Design all screens, states, and interactions for the feature.

tasks.title: Add a handoff checklist to the spec
tasks.description: List required assets, interaction notes, and API contracts.

tasks.title: Share the spec with an engineer for feedback
tasks.description: Schedule a 30-minute sync and record action items.

milestones.title: Design sprint write-up
milestones.outcome: A concise sprint report that showcases rapid problem solving and decision rationale.

tasks.title: Plan a 5-day sprint on a low-risk problem
tasks.description: Outline goals, schedule, and participants in a Google Doc.

tasks.title: Facilitate day-1 problem framing session
tasks.description: Lead a 60-minute workshop and capture insights on Miro.

tasks.title: Sketch solutions and vote on the best idea
tasks.description: Produce 3-5 quick sketches and run a dot-vote with teammates.

tasks.title: Prototype the chosen solution in Figma
tasks.description: Build a clickable prototype covering the core user flow.

tasks.title: Write a sprint retrospective report
tasks.description: Summarize outcomes, learnings, and next steps in 1-page PDF.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Polish leadership presence, senior interview skills, and advanced design strategy.

milestones.title: Design leadership & mentoring
milestones.outcome: Can coach junior designers and lead cross-functional design initiatives.

tasks.title: Read the “design leadership” article on Harvard business review
tasks.description: Absorb key principles in a 20-minute read.

tasks.title: Create a 30-minute mentorship session outline
tasks.description: Plan topics, activities, and feedback loops for a junior designer.

tasks.title: Run the mentorship session with a peer
tasks.description: Facilitate the plan and gather feedback on your coaching style.

tasks.title: Write a one-page design vision for your product area
tasks.description: Articulate long-term goals, user impact, and success metrics.

tasks.title: Share the vision in a team meeting
tasks.description: Present for 10 minutes and capture questions for improvement.

milestones.title: Senior interview preparation
milestones.outcome: Can confidently answer product, design, and behavioral interview questions.

tasks.title: Read the “design interview handbook” on GitHub
tasks.description: Study the free handbook sections on case studies and system design (30 min).

tasks.title: Write answers to 5 common senior design questions
tasks.description: Draft concise STAR-format responses in a Google Doc.

tasks.title: Do a mock interview with a senior peer
tasks.description: Record a 45-minute session and request detailed feedback.

tasks.title: Create a one-page cheat sheet of key metrics and trade-offs
tasks.description: Summarize how you measure impact for quick reference.

tasks.title: Reflect on interview performance and adjust answers
tasks.description: Note gaps and rehearse improved responses for 15 minutes.

milestones.title: Advanced systems & accessibility
milestones.outcome: Can design scalable systems and ensure inclusive experiences.

tasks.title: Read the WCAG 2.1 overview on W3C site
tasks.description: Skim the summary and key success criteria (20 min).

tasks.title: Audit an existing design for accessibility gaps
tasks.description: Use the axe Chrome extension to identify issues and list fixes.

tasks.title: Extend your Figma component library with accessible variants
tasks.description: Add focus states, color contrast versions, and documentation.

tasks.title: Design a responsive layout system for a dashboard
tasks.description: Create grid, spacing, and typography tokens that adapt to breakpoints.

tasks.title: Present the system to engineers and gather feedback
tasks.description: Run a 30-minute walkthrough and note integration concerns.
